result.description: Meta Marketing API: programmatically create and manage ad campaigns, ad sets, ads and creatives on Facebook, Instagram, Messenger and WhatsApp, and pull performance insights.
result.auth_detail: REST Marketing API: Facebook Login OAuth dialog (facebook.com/vXX/dialog/oauth, scope ads_read/ads_management) yields user access tokens. System user access tokens also work for server-to-server. Tokens sent as Bearer or access_token param. The Ads MCP server also supports OAuth, user token and system user token.
result.access_detail: Free self-serve developer app gets Limited access by default (heavily rate-limited, dev only, for own ad accounts). To manage other people's ad accounts in production, the app needs Full/Advanced access via App Review for ads_read/ads_management, plus Business Verification and ≥500 successful API calls in 15 days with <15% error rate. Meta must approve before end users can connect.
result.api_notes: Graph API based REST (versioned, e.g. v27.0). Covers campaigns, ad sets, ads, creatives, insights/reporting, audiences, catalogs, Business Manager, system users, pixels/datasets.
result.blocker: Public multi-tenant use needs Meta App Review (ads_read/ads_management advanced access) plus Business Verification; until then only own/test ad accounts via Limited access.

evidence.quote: Use the Marketing API to automate advertising across Meta technologies. The API provides functions for ad creation, management, and performance analysis.
If you're managing someone's ads, use the `scope` parameter to prompt them for the `ads_management` or `ads_read` permissions. Your app gets access when they click **Allow**.
You can also use a [system user access token](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/business-management-apis/system-users) to access the ads MCP server
Your tier is determined by whether your app has been approved through App Review.
Heavily rate-limited per ad account. For development only. Not for production apps running for live advertisers.
Access detailed insights and analytics to track ad performance and make data-driven decisions to improve outcomes
The server is remote-hosted at `https://mcp.facebook.com/ads` and works with any MCP-compatible AI agent.
Business verification is a process that allows us to verify your identity as a business entity, which we require if your app will access sensitive data.
